summary: AI-in-SDLC interaction logging, scoped historical import, workspace agents/skills, schemas, and verification evidence are in place. No invoice feature code was changed in this continuation; pre-existing user changes remain untouched.

findings.title: Imported metadata could retain credentials or unbounded values
findings.evidence: Code Reviewer finding F-01; metadata redaction and 1,024-character bounds are now applied to source, session ID, and source reference. Synthetic tests cover generic token assignments and URL basic-auth values.
findings.impact: Credential-bearing metadata could otherwise be copied outside the content redactor or create oversized records.
findings.recommendation: Keep best-effort recursive redaction and metadata bounds, and review logs before external sharing.
findings.verdict_reason: Implemented in the shared record constructor and covered by focused tests; redaction remains explicitly best effort.

findings.title: Directory imports could traverse unrelated private records
findings.evidence: Code Reviewer finding F-02; directory traversal now defaults to immediate children, nested traversal is opt-in via --recursive, and the canonical destination log is excluded.
findings.impact: Unbounded recursive ingestion could import data unrelated to the intended repository assignment.
findings.recommendation: Continue using explicit paths and dry-run before imports; only enable recursive traversal after reviewing the source tree.
findings.verdict_reason: Importer behavior and tests now enforce explicit, nonrecursive default scope and destination exclusion.

findings.title: Summary strings and unknown event types could be misclassified
findings.evidence: Code Reviewer finding F-05; string values such as "false" are rejected for is_summary and event types are checked against the supported set.
findings.impact: Incorrect labels weaken provenance and can make imported data misleading.
findings.recommendation: Keep strict JSON boolean and known-event validation for imports.
findings.verdict_reason: Importer rejects invalid summary types and unsupported event types, with regression tests.

findings.title: Interaction rows and structured reports needed separate contracts
findings.evidence: Code Reviewer finding F-04; a dedicated interaction schema was added and AGENTS.md now identifies the report schema separately.
findings.impact: Using a review-report schema for JSONL events would leave canonical records without a truthful machine-readable contract.
findings.recommendation: Validate the interaction log with the interaction schema and review artifacts with the report schema.
findings.verdict_reason: Both contracts are now distinct, and the validator supports JSONL interaction records and report JSON.

findings.title: The original report validator accepted malformed JSON types
findings.evidence: Code Reviewer finding F-03; type-safe checks now cover booleans, arrays, date-time values, enum values, unexpected top-level fields, interaction records, and JSONL line diagnostics.
findings.impact: Malformed evidence could pass or crash validation rather than producing actionable errors.
findings.recommendation: Run the validator on every generated report and the canonical interaction log.
findings.verdict_reason: Validator hardening is covered by tests, and the full current JSONL file was validated successfully.

findings.title: Interaction validator accepted fields outside the declared schema
findings.evidence: Final Code Reviewer finding R-01 identified that additionalProperties=false was not enforced by the custom interaction validator.
findings.impact: Nonconforming records could be reported valid even though they violate the interaction schema.
findings.recommendation: Reject unknown fields and add a regression test.
findings.verdict_reason: Unknown fields are rejected and a test now verifies the behavior.

findings.title: Directory imports could follow symlinks outside the selected source tree
findings.evidence: Final Code Reviewer finding R-02 identified that file symlinks could resolve outside the chosen directory.
findings.impact: An unrelated external transcript could be imported despite the nonrecursive default scope.
findings.recommendation: Reject symlinks and enforce resolved-path containment.
findings.verdict_reason: Source symlinks are rejected, resolved entries are checked against the selected directory, and an external-symlink regression test was added.

findings.title: Stop events could retain a local transcript path
findings.evidence: Final Code Reviewer finding R-03 identified that transcript_path was included in normalized Stop event content.
findings.impact: Usernames and private local filesystem layout could be exposed in the canonical log.
findings.recommendation: Omit the local path from logged event content.
findings.verdict_reason: The normalized Stop event now excludes transcript_path, with a regression test asserting the path is not stored.

findings.title: Boolean timestamp values could be treated as Unix timestamps
findings.evidence: Final reviewer finding INF-R1 noted Python treats bool as a subclass of int, so JSON true/false timestamps could be normalized as epoch seconds.
findings.impact: Malformed timestamps might appear as valid but misleading event times.
findings.recommendation: Classify booleans as unknown before numeric timestamp conversion.
findings.verdict_reason: Boolean detection now precedes numeric parsing and a test covers both true and false values.

findings.title: Concurrent append stress testing is not included
findings.evidence: The append implementation uses an OS-level lock and deduplicates IDs while holding that lock, but tests currently exercise sequential retries rather than simultaneous processes.
findings.impact: A future platform-specific locking regression might not be detected by the current fixture suite.
findings.recommendation: Consider adding a bounded multi-process append test if concurrent hook delivery becomes a supported operational requirement.
findings.verdict_reason: The current requirement is best-effort append/deduplication, the implementation is locked, and cross-platform stress behavior is outside this focused infrastructure completion.

checks.evidence: 21 tests passed, including final reviewer-fix regressions for symlink isolation, transcript path omission, additional interaction fields, and boolean timestamps.
OpenSpec reported the change is valid.
Every JSONL record present at the validation checkpoint passed interaction-record validation.
Evidence report validated against required fields, dispositions, types, and timestamps.
Two new assertions were incorrect; both were fixed and the rerun passed. The initial attempt from e2e also used the wrong working directory.
